instruction: How to configure ArgoCD to use an external Dex provider
output:
<think>
So the request is to configure ArgoCD to use an external Dex provider.
Let me reason through this.
For this, kubectl is the right tool — Kubernetes cluster management.
The -n flag means dry-run, no changes, which matters here because important to get the expected behavior.
The -p flag handles create parent directories as needed. Important because needed for this specific use case.
No need for complex pipelines here — one command is sufficient.
Check which namespace and context you're in before running destructive commands. Use --dry-run first.
</think>
kubectl patch configmap argocd-cm -n argocd --type merge -p '{"data":{"dex.config":"connectors:\n- type: oidc\n  id: dex\n  name: Dex\n  config:\n    issuer: https://dex.example.com\n    clientID: argocd-client\n    clientSecret: secret\n    insecureEnableGroups: true"}}'
